facts.assertion: Havering adopted its current Local Plan in 2021.
Havering identifies Reviewing and collecting evidence as the current Local Plan update stage.
Havering says the 2021 plan's Inspector requested an immediate review after adoption to reflect policy changes and identify sites suitable for new homes.
Havering's Local Plan update sequence places Regulation 18 consultation after the current evidence-review stage and adoption as the eighth stage.
The current update evidence base includes the Havering Character Study and four appendices.
The current update evidence base includes an Employment Land Review and Cluster Summary appendix.
The current update evidence base includes the Havering Archaeological Priority Areas Report.
The current update evidence base includes a Strategic Housing Market Assessment.
The current update evidence base includes an Open Space Assessment and indoor/outdoor sports needs and strategy documents.
The current update evidence base includes the Retail and Town Centre Study with capacity, health-check and household-survey volumes.
Havering publishes a new planning-applications list every Tuesday covering the previous seven days.
The current weekly planning page lists applications received from 14 to 20 July 2026.
Application P0380.26 at David Lloyd, Squirrels Heath Lane, Gidea Park was approved with conditions on 13 July 2026.
P0380.26 concerns an external spa garden and associated facilities, so its approval is a site-specific application decision rather than Local Plan allocation evidence.
Application P0574.26 at 7 Balgores Crescent, Squirrels Heath was Undecided on the current official record.
P0574.26 was received on 5 May 2026, validated on 18 May 2026 and has a Decision By date of 4 September 2026.
Application M0002.26 at land by David Lloyd, Squirrels Heath Lane was refused on 8 May 2026.
M0002.26 proposed a 20-metre telecommunications monopole with nine antennas, two transmission dishes, five cabinets and ancillary development.
Application P0495.26 at 83 Cecil Avenue remained Undecided even though its Decision By date was 15 July 2026.
A passed Decision By date on an Undecided application is not a planning decision and cannot be promoted to candidate 46142 future-growth evidence.
